body: Audit docs/tasks/AUDIT-BUILT-2026-11-05.md: B-20 the app's Jam client connects to the old Jam hub on port 8703 (server/legacy/hub), which the shipped compose neither runs nor publishes; the server has no Jam module. The first step is deciding where the hub lives, without ever having two implementations of one protocol. Also B-3 (Funnel limits) and B-18/B-10 (the server stalls under many people: measured).
